yourself, Your Eminence,

tell you. You may very
well be shocked...

^3355FFHigh Priest Zhed explained

scripts.speaker: Zhed
scripts.text:
We all understand that
you're already burdened
enough with your duties
as pope, but we feel that
you should take action soon.

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text:
We don't mean to force
you, Your Eminence, but
we don't have much time.
We're facing the possibility
of war, and we must stop it
in order to save Arunafeltz.

scripts.speaker: Zhed, Niren
scripts.text: Excuse me?

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
Niren, Zhed...
I'm glad that you all
finally came to me for
a solution to all this.
I'm young, but I remember
what I saw in the holy ground.

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
Don't you remember, Niren?
You found me in the holy
ground, and safely led me
out. But while I was there,
I saw ^3131FFYmir's Heart^000000.

scripts.speaker: Zhed
scripts.text:
How... How did you know
that was Ymir's Heart?

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
The priests in the Sky
Garden don't mind talking
freely around me. I guess
they looked at me more as
a child, rather than as pope.

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
I'm already aware of the
moderate priest group
conducting their cruel tests,
and of the hard liners building
their military power. However,
I couldn't really do anything.

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
Most people don't take my
position seriously because
of my age. Nobody believes
I can change the situation.
I've also heard everything
about what you did, Zhed.

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
I'm sorry that you were
punished by the other priests
for allowing an outsider to
enter the holy ground, but
I understand your reasons.
Isn't this the adventurer?

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
{0}...
I'm very glad to see you
again. Not only did you
share news of the outside
world with me, but you've
been protecting our peace.

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text:
I really didn't know...
How'd you feel about this,
or how much you actually
knew. I'm truly sorry, Your
Eminence. I'm ashamed
for underestimating you.

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
Please don't apologize,
Niren. If it weren't for you,
I'd be drawn into the utter
foolishness of the selfish
people in this temple. Niren,
you're like a mother to me.

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text:
Your Eminence...
Thank you. I feel
the same way...

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
Zhed...?
I need you to do
something for me.

scripts.speaker: Zhed
scripts.text:
Of course,
Your Eminence.

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
Write a report about the
tests conducted by the
moderates in Arunafeltz and
the Schwarzwald Republic,
and their relationship with
that Schwarzwald Corporation.

scripts.speaker: Zhed
scripts.text:
I'll get it done immediately,
Your Eminence. Thank you.

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text: Niren.

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text: Yes, Your Eminence?

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
Please collect the
evidence that proves
that the hard liners have
been gearing for war.

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text: Yes, Your Eminence.

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
I'll summon all the High
Priests and Priestesses
soon. I'd like the two of
you to stand by my side.
I won't let anyone disgrace
our holy ground with bloodshed.

scripts.speaker: Zhed
scripts.text:
As you command,
Your Eminence.

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
{0}...
I appreciate all your work
on behalf of Arunafeltz.
My influence may still be
weak, but I'll do my best
with Zhed and Niren's support.

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text:
I would be expecting
too much to ask you to
stay by my side. But I'd like
to thank you for all you've
done. But if it is Freya's
will, we'll meet again...

scripts.speaker: Pope
scripts.text: May Freya bless you...

Would you help me find my
lost bond of debt? You see,
the collateral I gave him
is really valuable to me.

scripts.text:

scripts.speaker: Muff
scripts.text:
I took this path in the
Papuchicha Forest to head
back home, and I must have
passed out near a river.
After that, my wallet with the
bond of debt was missing.

scripts.speaker: Muff
scripts.text:
I don't care about the
other stuff in my wallet,
but I really need my bond
of debt to get my collateral
back from that Belder.

scripts.speaker: Muff
scripts.text:
Well, the collateral was
this huge, stunningly
beautiful jewel. It's really
precious to me. But well,
I don't want to tell you
more about it.

scripts.speaker: Muff
scripts.text:
I understand if you don't
want to help me after
hearing that, but if you
change your mind, please
come talk to me again.

scripts.speaker: Muff
scripts.text:
H-hey! Where are you
going?! You can't just
leave me here! I need help!

scripts.speaker: Muff
scripts.text:
You didn't leave to
look for my wallet yet?
I think it's somewhere
in the Papuchicha Forest.
Please find the bond of debt
inside as soon as you can.

Is this wet, tattered
piece of paper the bond
of debt that you need?

scripts.speaker: Muff
scripts.text:
Yes, that's it!
Ugh, but look at it...
It's ruined! You can't
even read what's written
on it! I need... I need
to fix this somehow!

Do you have any ideas?
I mean, if we dried the
paper, the letters would

scripts.speaker: Muff
scripts.text:
I got it! There's this
famous inventor named
^FF0000Dorian^000000 in Izlude. I heard

scripts.speaker: Muff
scripts.text:
I don't know exactly

scripts.speaker: Muff
scripts.text:
Yes! Finally, I'm
free of debt! I've got
my jewel back, business
is doing well... Life sure
is good right now. Hahaha!

scripts.speaker: Muff
scripts.text:
Listen to me: never
take out a loan if you
can help it. And if you do,
borrow from someone
more reputable than...
Well, you know my story.
*Sigh*

scripts.speaker: Belder
scripts.text:
I ought to hire some
part-time promotional
workers... Some sexy
ladies ought to bring in
the customers by th--Oh!
Welcome to Belder Loans!
I'll promote your loans!
Uh...

scripts.speaker: Belder
scripts.text:
You? But you're a dude!
No sweaty, stinky, sleazy
man should be the image
of Belder Loans! We need
to exude trust, dependability,
and... And lady charms.

scripts.speaker: Belder
scripts.text:
You? Well, don't take
this the wrong way, but
all your curves? Wrong
places, honey. Later!

scripts.speaker: Belder
scripts.text:
Hey, aren't you
interested in a loan?
Better you come to
me than you relying
on some guy that'll
try to rip you off!

scripts.speaker: Belder
scripts.text:
Welcome! So, do you
need money fast? Belder
Loans get you the money
you need at low interest rates!
Ask About Muff

scripts.speaker: Belder
scripts.text:
Muff? Oh! Is that
supposed to be a name?
I thought you meant--No.
Nope. Doesn't ring a bell.

scripts.speaker: Belder
scripts.text:
Huh? Collateral?
Now why would I refuse
to take back his money
if I really loaned it to him?
Leave me alone now, this kind
of talk is bad for business!

scripts.speaker: Belder
scripts.text:
He really found his bond
of debt? Damn it--I mean,
what a surprise! That's,
uh, real good for him.
Now that I think of it, I did
loan a Muff money once.

scripts.speaker: Belder
scripts.text:
What's with that dirty look?
I've got nothing to hide!
Can't you see that I'm
the victim here? Me!
Just... Scram before you
make me more upset.

scripts.speaker: Belder
scripts.text:
Welcome! Did you need
money fa--Oh. Hey, it's
you again, the do-gooder.
Why don't you do me some
good, and go back where
you came from. Jerk.

scripts.speaker: Belder
scripts.text:
Cash flow problems?
Well, I'm your solution!
I offer unsecured loans
at an extremely low interest
rate, twenty-four hours a day!
Belder Loans is Alberta's best!

Dig Up the Spot
Cancel

This would be a lot

Only a little more to go...

I dropped it! I have to

This is the same spot

Huh. There's a weird

I can't just go looking at

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Ugh, just like a member
of the working class:
hoarding all your items
like a packrat? Have the
decency to relocate your
goods to Kafra Storage, please.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
You must be in awe
of my elegant, artistic
touch. In my hands, almost
anything can become a
work of art... Even you~

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
I am Inventor Dorian,
and I welcome you to my
workship. All I create is
infused with art's essence~
So... How may I assist you?
I want to use your Magic Dryer.
I want to be your student.
No, thanks.

This Bond of Debt
My Hair
I'm just curious.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:

recognition. Only my creation
can restore the life that
nature has taken away! Yes...
You were right to come here.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:

the Mystic Dryer de Elegance
works. A glamourous ruby
engine whose design was born
of my genius, generates a
powerful magnetic field.

magnetic field operates

Wavelength Theory^000000. Now,
pearl inset sensors detect
the amount of calibration...

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:

You were listening?

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:

ask you this: what is the
main theory by which the
Mystic Heater de Elegance
operates? Hmm? Well?

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
That's right. My apologies.
I suppose I misjudged you.
Yes, the magnetic field can
restore the shape and integrity
of damaged, inanimate objects.
However, there is a problem.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
The ruby engine is broken,
and I've been too busy with
other projects as ordered by
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
I'll need your assistance
to fix the engine. Alright?

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
If you help me fix the
Mystic Dryer de Elegance,
I'll allow you to use it
as much as you like. First,
I'd like you to gather all
of the repair materials.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Please procure
^FF000020 Rusty Screws^000000,
^FF000010 Iron Ores^000000,
^FF00005 Steel^000000,
^FF00002 Rubies^000000, and
^FF000010 Red Gemstones^000000.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Once you bring all the
repair materials, I'll
explain how you can
repair the Mystic
Dryer de Elegance.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Oh? You sound dissatisfied
with my explanation. Well...
I surely can't let you use the
machine unless you fathom
how it works. Otherwise,
you just might break it.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Were you too bored while
listening to me speak?
Ah! This wound! It's so...
Alas! It's too emotional!
I am seriously hurt!

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
How can you compare my
Mystic Dryer de Elegance
to a simple hair dryer?
Your comment offends me!
I'm no mere engineer...
I'm a true virtuoso!

Astounding, isn't it?

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Ah, my apologies.
Too many have asked, so
I now only accept beautiful
female students. Don't be
too disappointed: I know
you can find someone else.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Mademoiselle, it is my
honor to meet you: even
the moon covers its face,
and roses raise their thorns,
shameful of themselves
and jealous of your beauty.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Ah! But why go under the
pretense of being my student
when we can leisurely spend
time together as lovers?
Won't you--Mademoiselle?
Wait, where are you going?

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
I don't have enough
time for trivel, so
please leave me to my
artistic endeavors and
bother me no longer.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Ugh, your behavior
from before disgusts me...
But those pitiful eyes...
Seeking sympathy. Ah,
you're only human.
I shall forgive you.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Alright then. Please
listen carefully this time,
and don't insult my pride
again. When you are ready,
please come talk to me.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Ah, did you bring all
the materials I need to
repair the Mystic Dryer
de Elegance? Let me take
a glance at what you brought...

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Ah, well done. Now
that the materials are
ready, I can instruct you on
how to repair the machine.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
I expect you to fail
a few times, but the
Mystic Dryer de Elegance
is designed for durability:
even if you tried, you'd
have trouble scratching it.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
First, insert a new rough
ruby into the ruby engine,
and tighten the screw on
the joint until you hear
a ^0000FFclick^000000. You'll break it
if you tighten it further.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Next you'll need to
operate the four switches
coded by the colors red,
blue, yellow, and green.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Press the ^0000FFRed^000000 switch
if the engine is in 1st
Gear. Press the ^0000FFBlue^000000
switch in 2nd Gear,
^0000FFYellow^000000 for 3rd, and
^0000FFGreen^000000 for 4th.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
The engine's sound is the
only indicator of which
gear is running. You'll
have to figure that out
on your own. I'm sorry
I designed it that way...

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Ah, one last tip!
If you enter the correct
engine gear, the machine
will start without a problem,
even if you press the same
switch more than once.

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Please let me know
if you get it started so
I can verify if the Mystic
Dryer de Elegance is fully
operational. Good luck now~

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:

some materials. Well, we're
in no rush. If you already
forgot, then let me remind
you what you need to bring...

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:

This is a testament to my

scripts.speaker: Dorian
scripts.text:
Who are you?
Don't you dare lay
a hand on my precious
masterpiece inventions!

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
You're carrying too much
stuff with you. Dump it
in Kafra Storge, sell it,
drop it, whatever, before
you come talk to me, okay?

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Have you heard of the
Four Cursed Jewels?
I hear that one of them,
the Diamond of Destruction,
just appeared recently.
What I'd do to find it...

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
{0}, right?
Don't be too suprised.
I've heard of you here
and there. Heh heh~!
How can I help you?
What'd you hear?
Bye!

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
I wanted to ask you about
the Four Cursed Jewels.
All the merchants in the
area are talking about them.
Anyway, I was able to obtain
the Diamond of Destruction!

(^666666Hmm... He might
be talking about that
jewel Muff gave to Belder
as collateral for his debt.^000000)

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
I paid a hefty sum for it,
but then I lost it after
just a few days. I kept it
under high security, but
that didn't stop the thief...

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
It's a risky job, but
I want to employ you to
find where my diamond went.
It'd be best if you could get
it back, but I can understand
if you can't. You up for it?
Sure, I'll help you.
No, sorry.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Great! I knew it was
a good idea to find you.
The thief didn't leave any
clues, but he should have
some problems selling the gem.
It's one of a kind, you know.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Visiting the large
jewelry shops in the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
would be a good start.
Their merchants know the
most about those jewels.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
The thief will also have
to sell the jewel to a jeweler
that can afford astronomical
prices. There are three big
locations you should check.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Find ^0000FFJhonnita^000000 in Alberta,
^0000FFKimeunbang^000000 in Payon, and
^0000FFLeblo^000000 in Geffen. They wanted 
that diamond badly too, so
they'll remember if they
heard any clues about it.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Please don't let them
know I've hired you to
investigate that diamond.
They won't speak to you
if they figure out that
I've sent you to them.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Well, I'll be right
here. I hope you come
back with some good news.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Really? I went through
a lot of trouble to find
you, but... I understand.
If you have a change of
heart, I'll be willing to
hire you for your expertise.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
So it's true...
People say you're
just a Novice, but
you still help them
out with their problems.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
I've got a few buddies
in the Swordman Association.
They dropped your name when
I mentioned I was looking
for someone smart and strong.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Heh, so you really
are one of those holy
knights. I'm glad to
have met you for myself.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
I didn't think a member
of the clergy would be so
strong, but you know, your
reputation precedes you.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Hey, if I didn't know
your name, how could I call
myself a Merchant? You set
an example for us all~

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
We have a mutual friend,
you know that? Aragham
really spoke highly of you.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
I know a guy who knows
a guy in the Alchemist Guild.
Around their parts, it sounds
like you're pretty hot stuff.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Magic is totally beyond
my understanding, but
if it gets the job done,
it can't be all bad.
I hear you're really
good at that stuff.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Heh, it sounds like almost
anyone who's anyone in
Morocc knows who you are.
Pleasure to make your
acquaintance~

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Anyone who's used
a bow seems to drop
your name when it comes
to accuracy and heroism.
Hard to believe that I'm
actually talking to you~

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Is it really true?
I hear you sing
like an angel...

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Is it really true?
I hear you dance
like the devil...

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Me and your old master,
Phoenix, we go way back.
He had nothing but pride
when he talked about you~

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
I heard your name from
this spiritual message
I got from a dream. That
doesn't sound crazy to
you, does it?

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Aren't you the least
bit curious how I know
about you? Wait, come back!
I'm not really that suspicious!

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Find ^0000FFJhonnita^000000 in Alberta,
^0000FFKimeunbang^000000 in Payon, and
^0000FFLeblo^000000 in Geffen. They wanted 
that diamond badly too, so
they'll remember if they
heard any clues about it.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Please don't let them
know I've hired you to
investigate that diamond.
They won't speak to you
if they figure out that
I've sent you to them.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Are you still investigating
the diamond's whereabouts?
Well, I hope you can bring
me back good news soon.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Oh, you're back.
Made any headway in
your investigation of the
Diamond of Destruction?
Explain What You Learned

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
What?! The Z Gang stole
my diamond? No wonder!
I bet they wanted to use its
curse for something evil.
How about the jewel?
Did you retrieve it?
Give Diamond of Destruction

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Oh! Great! So it was
in the Z Gang's hideout?
Wow, even after hearing so
much about you, you still
exceeded my expectations!

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Thank God, I finally
have this back! Ah, and
as for your payment...
Well, I don't know if
it's enough for what you
did, but I hope you like it.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Now that I have the
Diamond of Destruction
again, I can research
more about its strange
properties. I'll contact you
again if I need your help.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Ah, I hear from a friend
in Morocc that you happened
to obtain the Unlucky Emerald.
I'm sure it's one of the Four
Cursed Jewels. You wouldn't
mind if I look at it, do you?
No!
Sure, why not?

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
No? Well, I'm sure you
have your reasons. Still,
maybe I can learn something
that would benefit both of
us if I examined it.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Ah, I appreciate it!
Now, let's see here...

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Yes, judging from its
characteristic shape, this
is the cursed emerald.
Like me, you now possess
one of the Four Cursed Jewels.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Hm? Did you happen to
misplace your emerald?
I mean, it's not with you...

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Tell me, what were
you planning to do with
the Unlucky Emerald?
I'm going to sell it.
I'm going to study it.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Oh, you weren't going
to keep it? I wish I could
afford to buy it from you...
But I've had enough trouble
buying the Diamond of
Destruction.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
You already met several
renown jewelers while
you were looking for the
dimaond. Why don't you ask
them if they'll buy that
Unlucky Emerald from you?

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Ah, I applaud your
thirst for knowledge,
your quest to seek truth.
If you really want an expert
to look at the emerald, talk
to this scholar in Comodo.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
This man is an antique
appraiser, an specialist in
ancient artifacts and treasure.
I highly recommend consulting
him since he's been invaluable
in my own jewel research.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
I heard that you obtained
the Unlucky Emerald from
a friend in Morocc. Let me
warn you that you might not
be strong enough to handle
its power. Be careful.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
If you're not wary,
its curse might destroy
you. Understand?

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Thank you for all
you've done for me. I'll
continue my research in the
cursed jewel's powers, and
I'll contact you if I need your
help again. Take care~

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
I don't have the funds
to buy your emerald at
a fair price, but why don't
you ask the other jewelers?
They might be interested
in buying your jewel.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Ah, you're back~
So were you able to
sell the Unlucky Emerald?
Everyone seems scared!

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Ah, I see now. They
must be too afraid of
that particular jewel's
curse. Huh. Weird.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
I guess the Diamond of
Destruction is considered
pretty safe since it's been
around for a while without
any strange incidents.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
You just dug up the
emerald? I suppose it
might be too soon to sell it.
Not too many people will
test their luck with that gem,
now that I think about it.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Ah, here's an idea.
Why don't you ask my
scholar friend in Comodo
to examine it? Maybe you
can learn more about the
emerald's so-called curse.

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
I'll go ahead and send
him a message ahead of
time so that he'll know to
expect your arrival, okay?

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Why don't you visit my
scholar friend in Comodo,
and ask him to examine your
Unlucky Emerald? The more
you learn about that so-called
curse, the better. Good luck!

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Oh, so what have you
learned about the Unlucky
Emerald so far? Hmmm. Yes,
very intriguing. Good luck
with your research efforts~

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Have you heard of
the Four Cursed Jewels?
I wish to retrieve my
Diamond of Destruction,
but whoever has it has
kept it well hidden...

scripts.speaker: Ibrahim
scripts.text:
Psst, adventurer!
You're {0}, right?
There's something
I'd like to discuss
with you in private!

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
Oh, it's always nice
to see a new face~
So were you interested
in selling or buying
a jewel? We only carry
the best. Hahahaha!
What's the most popular jewel?
Do you know Diamond of Destruction?

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
Ah, take a look at this
lustrous ruby. Isn't it
just breathtaking? It can
be yours for the specially
discounted price of just
1,000,000 zeny!

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
Wait, where are you--?
Damn, I shouldn't have
marked it up so much.
Rookie mistake, rookie
mistake! I'm a professional!

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
Diamond of Destruction?
Heh heh! A rookie like you
wouldn't appreciate its true
value. I wanted it so badly,
but that Ibrahim was much
luckier that I was...

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
It makes me so upset to
think about how I lost to
him. All the big jewelers
are trying to snatch up
the Four Cursed Jewels...
But only one showed up so far.

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
Hey. You look familiar.
You're not one of my
regulars, are you?
No, couldn't be.
You're not dressed
richly enough. No offense.

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
So you here to sell
any Garlets, or did you
come to spend your life
savings on my jewels?
Show me some jewels...
I have a rare emerald to sell...

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
It couldn't hurt to
show you my wares, but...
I doubt you can afford them.
Jewels aren't cheap, you know?

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
Oh, I get it now. You want
to give one as a present to
some woman. Isn't that typical?
Can't you come up with a more
creative way to buy some
woman's love? Huh?

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
Sorry, sweetheart, but
I have a strict ''no window
shopping'' policy.

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
Rare emerald, eh?
It better not be something
like a Garlet or a Zargon!
Sometimes you guys make
that kind of mistake.
Okay, let's see...

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
...........................Um.
It's an incredibly nice
emerald, but I can't take
this off your hands. Er,
would you be on your way?
Huh? But why?

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
J-just get out of my
shop! Go... Go to Payon
and talk to Kimeunbang!
Y-yeah, and don't come back!

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
What'd I tell you, huh?
I don't want you here
in my shop anymore!

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
Look, I'll level with you.
Rumors spread fast amongst
us jewelers. Nobody will get
near you if they know you
have that jewel. You get it
now? Please... Stay back...

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
I don't want anything
to do with your weird
emerald or with you.
Aren't you leaving
already? Go away!

scripts.speaker: Jhonnita
scripts.text:
Are you here to buy or
sell any jewels? I always
buy high and sell low.
Come to me for all of
your gem related needs~

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
Zzzz... Huh?
Why'd you wake me?
Such a good dream too.
Go to another jewelry shop,
I don't feel like opening up.
What's wrong?
Diamond of Destruction?

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
I'm just disappointed.
I was so close to getting
that Diamond of Destruction.
So close! Belder, my business
partner, actually snatched
it up from some poor sap.

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
Somehow, Belder ended up
returning the jewel. I was
going to buy the jewel from
the original owner, but then
this upstart jeweler got to
it before I could. Damn it!

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
This was a monumental
failure. I haven't been
able to sleep, I don't want
to work. Ugh. Well, thanks
for letting me get that off
my chest. I feel a bit better.

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
Here, take this as
a little gift. Not all of us
jewelers are as greedy
as you think we are. Heh.

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
Oh! That diamond is the
very reason for my agony!
I was so close to getting it...
But then someone got to the
diamond before I did. Argh!

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
I don't feel like opening
my shop any time soon, but
you can always come back later.

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
Oh, hello. Looks like
I'm back in business~
I have a jewel to sell.
How are you?

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
Really? Alright, just
give me a minute to
appraise your gem.

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but I just
can't buy this emerald.
It's... It's too big of
a risk. The rumors I keep
hearing, they're just horrible.

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
Hm? Where's this
jewel you were talking
about? Did you forget
to bring it with you?

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
I don't even feel like
talking about my business.
I've been considering closing
up shop for good, actually.

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
No jeweler around will
buy that cursed emerald.
I'm really sorry. You can
try talking to Ibrahim, though.
He's the one that got that
Diamond of Destruction.

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
Ugh... The stress
of the jewel business
is finally getting to me.
Oh well, I've had a good run...

scripts.speaker: Kimeunbang
scripts.text:
I don't feel like opening
my shop any time soon, but
you can always come back later.

scripts.speaker: Leblo
scripts.text:
Oh, I've heard about
you. You're the one that's
been asking questions about
the Diamond of Destruction.

scripts.speaker: Leblo
scripts.text:
Don't be so suprised:
word travels fast in the
jewel industry. Well, if you
want to learn more, you'll
have to do something for
me first. We have a deal?
Deal.
No, thanks.

scripts.speaker: Leblo
scripts.text:
I've been suffering back
pain lately, and none of
the medicines do any good.
I resorted to seeing this
famous doctor in Payon, but
then I totally screwed it up.

scripts.speaker: Leblo
scripts.text:
She was such a nag, and
I said something... unpleasant
to her. Now she refuses to
examine me! But if I sent
you, then you could get
some medicine for me.

scripts.speaker: Leblo
scripts.text:
She knows my symptoms
so if you make her happy,
she'll give you my medicine...
I hope. Anyway, her name is
^0000FFWola^000000, and she's in Payon.

scripts.speaker: Leblo
scripts.text:
Oh, yeah? Well, that's
fine with me. I don't
have anything to lose.

scripts.speaker: Leblo
scripts.text:
Please look for a female
doctor named ^0000FFWola^000000 in Payon.
Do what you can to get my
medicine from her... Oh,
and try to be nice~

scripts.speaker: Leblo
scripts.text:
Oh? Is that... Is that my
medicine? Thank goodness!
 Hm? Oh, so I misunderstood
 her. I thought she was awfully
 arrogant, but she was just
 concerned for my health.

scripts.speaker: Leblo
scripts.text:
I better make it a point
to properly apologize to
her the next time I see her.

scripts.speaker: Leblo
scripts.text:
Right, I need to tell
you about the Diamond of
Destruction. Listen carefully.
A while ago, a young couple
tried to sell me that very
jewel. Suspicious, eh?

scripts.speaker: Leblo
scripts.text:
I had no interest in
buying it, so I actually
offered them a much lower
price than they hoped.
Now that I think about it...

scripts.speaker: Leblo
scripts.text:
That man and woman looked
like the members of that
infamous Z Gang. Heh!
I should have reported it,
but... You know. Back
pain and all that.

scripts.speaker: Leblo

Your clients gave you something?

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
Oh, yeah. The guys that
hired me said that if I waited
at the treasure site, someone
would eventually come to help
me out on the magic end.
I don't know who he is, though.

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
Oh, yeah. They mentioned
something about him coming
a bit from the west. Maybe
he's over in Comodo?

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
Oh, yeah. They gave me
this weird document labeled
''^FF0000[Open^000000.'' I don't know how
to use it at all, though.

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
Oh, yeah. They gave me
this weird document labeled
''^FF0000[Unlock^000000.'' I don't know how
to use it at all, though.

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
Oh, yeah. Let's see here.
Ah, here's the document
that they gave me. It's kind
of a bit torn, though.

^3355FFThe torn document
is labeled ''^FF0000[Open^3355FF.''^000000

^3355FFThe torn document
is labeled ''^FF0000[Unlock^3355FF.''^000000

Wait, how could you not
know how to use this?
Didn't you get a chance
to talk to your clients?

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
I haven't even met them.
I just get their instructions
through the mail. Everything
is through a medium with these
guys. I guess they've got their
eyes on me too, but whatever.

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
I guess they hired me because
they really want the treasure,
but don't want to tip anyone
off that they're looking for 
it, or that they have it.

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
Anyway, all I know is that
this piece of paper is supposed
to do something. But I guess
I'm not smart enough to figure
it out. Maybe you'll have
better luck with them.

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
You know, if you can actually
find that guy who was supposed
to help me but never showed up,
maybe he'll understand how to
use that document. Go ahead
and take 'em. Good luck, now.

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
I already told you everything
I know. You'd be better off
finding that guy over in
Comodo, or the rest of
that torn document.

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
Now that I think about it,
maybe the treasure can be
obtained by two people?
I mean, they planned for
me to go with that guy. Eh,
best not to think about it.

scripts.speaker: Man
scripts.text:
Heh! Looks like I'll be
headed home soon~

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text: Whoa, don't get so close!

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text: Whoa, don't get so close!
Why are you hiding here?

Why are you hiding here?
Didn't the Z Gang hire you
to dig up some treasure?

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text: Huh? Z Gang? Treasure?

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
Huh? Wait, tell me the
truth. Did you actually
meet the Z Gang?

I not only met the Z Gang,
I also captured them. I've
come looking for you to
find out more about this
buried treasure.

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
I get it now. You must
have met that other guy
they hired to get the
treasure. Huh. He's got one
half of the spell to open it,
and I've got the other.

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
Well, you can have this,
the rest of the magic spell.
Let me warn you, though,
there's something weird
about the spell, and the
treasure itself.

^3355FFYou received a torn
document that reads
''^FF0000Seseame]^000000.''

^3355FFYou received a torn
document that reads
''^FF0000Treasure]^000000.''

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
I don't understand why they
went through the hassle of
splitting this spell in two
parts. There must be some
reason. Whatever it is, it
must be pretty important.

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
I guess maybe you need
two people to move the
treasure? Well, whatever.
Good luck finding that
treasure. Farewell now!

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text: Whoa, don't get so close!
Ask About Treasure

I've come looking
for information
about the treasure.

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
You... You've come
looking for me?!
Ugh, I'm cornered!
I'm not going down
without a fight!

What? No, it's not like
that. I met this treasure
hunter in Morocc that said
I could find you around here.

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
Treasure hunter...?
Oh, then you already
know about the treasure...

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
If I'm right, then you
need the other half of
the spell to open the
treasure. Here, you can
take it. I have no use
for it, anyway.

^3355FFYou received a torn
document that reads
''^FF0000Sesame]^000000.''

^3355FFYou received a torn
document that reads
''^FF0000Treasure]^000000.''

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
Now would you just get
out of here? If you couldn't
already tell, I'm hiding from
some people. I told you all
I know, so do me a favor,
and don't tell anyone I'm here!

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
Aren't you going to
dig up that treasure?
You have both parts of
the spell that you need:
I already gave you the
''^FF0000Treasure]^000000'' part, right?

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
Anyway, now that the
Z Gang is captured,
it might be safe enough
for me to go back home.

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
Would you do me a favor,

my hiding place?

Anyway, now that the

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
Would you do me a favor,
and just get out of here

my hiding place?

scripts.speaker: Man in Hiding
scripts.text:
Heh! Looks like it's
safe for me to come out
of hiding, and just go home!
But maybe I should stick
around here a little longer,
just to be on the safe side.

^3355FFYou're carrying too many
items: there's no way you

^3355FFThere's something

Unngh! I-it won't...!

^3355FFNo matter how hard
you try, you can't dig

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
I'm an antique appraiser.
You may think of me as similar
to jewel appraisers, but I can
appraise the historical value
of antiques in addition to their quality and monetary value.

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
Oooh. You must be the
one sent by Ibrahim, right?
You're the one that found
that rare emerald, one of
the accursed jewels?

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
I'm very interested in the
Cursed Jewels, and have been
researching them. You came
to just the right person if you
wanted to learn more about
the emerald that you found.

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
Hello, how may
I help you today?
Ask About Cursed Jewel

I came to ask you
about a Cursed Jewel.

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
Let's see... Ah, did
you come to ask about
the Diamond of Destruction?
No, it's the Unlucky Emerald.

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
Ah, the Unlucky Emerald?
Yes, that was the most recent
Cursed Jewel to be discovered.
Let's see, where did I put all
of my notes about that?

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
Would you mind coming
back later? I'm not sure
where I misplaced my notes...

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
Ah, let's see now.
There's a record here
entitled, ''The Story of the
Cursed Jewel.'' According
to this, no one knows where
these jewels were first found.

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
The first incident involving
the jewel involved a Comodo
resident that used the jewel
to pay a gambling debt. He
committed suicide after he
paid his debt, which is a pity.

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
He didn't tell anyone
where he found the jewel
before he died, so we have
no way of determining the
jewel's true origins.

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
After it was sold, the
jewel came into a rich man's
possession. However, he lost
his fortune and was completely
ruined after obtaining it. Hence the moniker, ''Unlucky Emerald.''

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
Then the emerald came into
the hands of a noble lady
who mysteriously died at
a young age. The emerald's
had thousands of owners
who just... Died.

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
What's disturbing is that
the emerald's curse seems
to grow stronger with each
life it takes away. Um, and
your jewel perfectly matches
the descriptions, so, uh...

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
You are the new owner
of the Unlucky Emerald.
No one will buy that from
you while it's still cursed.
For the sake of your life,
you must break that curse.

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
Now, holy spells won't work
on this kind of curse. You'll
need to talk to a shaman.
I think he lives in... Alberta?
He can summon the dead
and act as a medium for you.

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
The idea is for you to talk
to the spirits killed by this
emerald through that shaman.
And I'm sure he'll be pretty
excited to see that you have
the Unlucky Emerald with you.

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
Please find that shaman
in Alberta, and ask if he can
help you break the curse
on that Unlucky Emerald.

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
Wait, you're telling me
that the emerald was cursed
by the vindictive spirit of
some warrior? Interesting...
I should record this in my
research notes. Thank you!

scripts.speaker: Scholar
scripts.text:
Some jewels are said to
be possessed by ghosts
or evil spirits that will bring
misfortune to their owners,
drive them to death or
insanity, that sort of thing.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
The spiritual realm is
the source of my sorcery.
Do not understimate the
power of the spirits!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Oh? Heh heh!
You're carrying
something very
valuable, aren't you?

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
You! Yes... I can sense
them... The angry spirits of
your ancestors! You haven't
made any offerings to them,
have you? You must appease
them before they torment you!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Quickly, now! It is
imperative that you give me
500,000 zeny immediately
so that I can comfort their
souls before they wreck
havoc on your life!
Actually, I have a Cursed Jewel.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Jewel...? Oh, a Cursed
Jewel! Hahaha! So that's
what that evil aura was!
My mistake! Say, do you
mind if I take a look at it?

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
So this bauble's the
Unlucky Emerald? Yes,
it's definitely cursed.
If you don't break the
curse soon, it'll consume
your soul. Not a good thing.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
I need to perform
a ritual to break the
curse. I'll charge you
200,000 zeny for the service.
It's expensive, but I'm saving
your life and risking mine.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Hm? Did you forget to
bring the jewel? Hurry,
and bring it back to me.
You need to break that
curse before the jewel
can devour your soul!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Did you bring the money?
We must appease the spirits
possessing the soul, and to
do that, I will need to perform
a ritual that will be taxing
on my body and spirit.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Good, good. I see that
you've brought the money.
I can now begin the ritual.
If all goes well, you'll be
free of your curse, and I can
buy some Prontera real estate.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Please come back soon
after I've completed the
preparations for the ritual.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
You... You don't have
200,000 zeny? I'm sorry,
but I cannot perform the
ritual for free, even if
your soul is at stake.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Hmm... You know the
money you gave me?
Apparently, it wasn't
enough. One of the spirits
was about to enter me, but...

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
It left in disgust after
it learned that I was trying
to break the curse for only
200,000 zeny. I think...
I think I need 100,000 zeny
more for this to be effective.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Good, you've returned!
Did you bring the 100,000
zeny like I asked? It's a small
price considering that I'm
saving your very soul.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Ah, perfect!
Hopefully, the
spirits will be more
cooperative this time.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Yes, the vindictive
spirit in this jewel
will be most impressed
by your sincere efforts.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
You didn't? Do you know
what it's like to have
your soul consumed? Let
me tell you, it's a lot
more painful than parting
with a paltry 100,000 zeny!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
At long last, the
spirits and I are one.
The ritual may now begin.
Ohhhhhhhhhhhmmmmm...

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text: Hhhkkk... Arrrgh...!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Th-this emerald!
So many lives! Money
alone won't break this
curse! It's time to get
serious and suppress
this jewel's power!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Remember the items
I tell you to bring, and
come back with them
as quickly as you can!
Both of our lives are in
danger until you do!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Bring me
^FF00001 Holy Water^000000,
^FF00001 Red Blood^000000,
^FF00001 Witherless Rose^000000,
^FF00001 Crystal Blue^000000, and
^FF00001 Wind of Verdure^000000.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Hurry! Although the spirits
are eternal, they don't like
to be kept waiting! Don't
question this great irony,
and get those items now!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
You brought the items?!
Quickly! Place them in
my hands! We can't afford
to waste any more time!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Thank goodness.
Now... Let me begin...
Uhhkk... Argh! Wait!
I... I see someone...
Covered in blood? Yes...
He's staring at something.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
There's a sword behind it.
He's... He's just been in
a fight? I can smell...
His bloodlust. I can't tell
if he cursed the jewel of
if he's another victim...

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Damn it! It's not clear
to me! We need to figure
out if what I'm seeing is
the root of the curse...
What can we do to--Right!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
I'm not sure how helpful
he'll be, but there is an
archaeologist in Juno that
might know more about this
specific jewel. Hopefully,
he will have the answer.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
For now, the jewel's
curse is beyond my power.
However, if you can determine
the source of the curse, then
I will be able to help you.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
You... Forgot?!
Your body and soul are in
jeopardy and you forgot?!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Bring me
^FF00001 Holy Water^000000,
^FF00001 Red Blood^000000,
^FF00001 Witherless Rose^000000,
^FF00001 Crystal Blue^000000, and
^FF00001 Wind of Verdure^000000!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
That antique appraiser...
He wouldn't know anything
more about the jewel, but
that archaeologist in Juno
will hopefully have some
new information we can use.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Ah, you're back.
So did you learn
anything new about
the Unlucky Emerald?
The archaeologist said...

The archaeologist said...
Well, he said that there
is no curse on the jewel.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
What? How dare he refute
what I just told you?!
Is he calling me a liar?
There was a vindictive
warrior's soul inside
that very emerald!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Then again, there's no
point fighting someone
that doesn't believe in
the spirit realm. However,
I wasn't lying. My honor
as a shaman is at stake!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
In fact, I'll prove it to you
by reading the message
inside this emerald. Bring
me the jewel, and I'll summon
the warrior spirit inside it.
Just let me rest a bit first.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Alright. By my pride
as a shaman, I'll provide
this service to you free
of charge! Can't have
anyone thinking I'm
some kind of quack...

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Hmmmm...
Hmmmm...
I... I see.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Huh. Well, what do you
know? There is no curse.
However, it's not true that
only Comodo's prodigal son
was killed over this jewel.
There are many more...

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Go yonder to the town
of Geffen, head west, and
seek the high ground that
is over the bridge. You know...
Leave Geffen through the west
gate and find a high place.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Trust me. You'll find
something there that will
react to the power of that
emerald you possess.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Hmpf! That arrogant
archaeologist! He doesn't
know what he's talking about!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
You don't have the
emerald with you?
I hope you didn't
lose it somewhere.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Go yonder to the town
of Geffen, head west, and
seek the high ground that
is over the bridge. You know...
Leave Geffen through the west
gate and find a high place.

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
Trust me. You'll find
something there that will
react to the power of that
emerald you possess.
Don't forget to bring
that emerald with you!

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
What did I tell you?
That jewel brings very
bad fortune. Though, I'm
not sure why the warrior
spirit inside wouldn't talk
to me. What's with that?

scripts.speaker: Shaman
scripts.text:
It's been a long time
since I've done these
rituals. I feel thoroughly
drained of my spiritual energy.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
There's so much to do!
How am I going to handle
all of this research? Don't
panic, don't panic, just
one thing at a time!

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
Oh, I've heard about you
from that antique appraiser
in Comodo... You're the one
that dig up the Unlucky
Emerald, right? Would
you mind if I take a look?

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
Ah, it's no wonder so
many people want it.
This emerald is so huge
and... It's beautiful! So...
I'm guessing you needed
my help with something?
Ask About the Jewel's Curse
Show Off Jewel

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
The jewel's curse?
Hah! You believe in that
old superstition? Oh, so
you wanted to break the
jewel's curse? Mmpf. Hahah!
You're not dead yet, right?

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
It's all a load of bunk!
Only one man died while
keeping this jewel in his
possession, that gambler in
Comodo that used it to pay
off his gambling debts.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
This jewel happened to be
lost for a long time, and it
just reappeared. That's all.
Lots of myths and legends
surround extremely valuable
gems like this one.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
Anyway, there's no curse.
Believe what you want to,
but that happens to be my
professional opinion,
based on my research.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
Wow...
That jewel sure
is freakin' huge...

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
You lost the jewel?
Well, maybe it's not
all bad. History shows
that many people were
ruined by suddenly coming
upon vast fortunes, you know?

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
The vindictive soul
of a warrior is just
drifting around in the
world of the living?
I don't think I want to
believe what you're saying.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
I personally feel that
old shaman's a fraud, but...
You should have the freedom
to decide what you believe.
But don't let it bother you.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
Are you talking about
ghosts again? Fine. For
the sake of the argument,
let's say the jewel actually
possesses the soul of
some fallen warrior.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
It's not unfathomable for
people with huge debts to
kill themselves, or for
warriors to perish while
fighting Cobolds. Still...
I'll see what I can learn.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
That reminds me...
I've got some records about
an adventurer group that died
in the field west of Geffen
that you were talking about.
Let me see if I can find them.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
Ah, you're back! I found
those records I told you
about. It's a witness's
account of what happened
when those people died
west of Geffen.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
What's interesting is that
the warrior you keep talking
about wasn't killed by Cobolds
at all, according to what this
guy wrote. Let's see...
Ah, it's over here.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
''^666666When the chief and his
soldiers arrived, the battle
was over. Dead bodies lay
everywhere, but there was
one warrior covered in blood,
half conscious, but living.^000000''

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
Strange, isn't it?
This is from a journal
written by a retired soldier
that lives in Prontera now.
It might be a good idea to
see if you can talk to him.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
There's a retired soldier
that actually witnessed what
happened in the field west
of Geffen. You should try
to find him in Prontera, and
see what you can learn.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
Ah, that's... That's
very profound. That one
warrior went berserk when
he realized he was too weak
to protect his comrades?
He lost total control...

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
I better talk to that
old soldier and get the
full story on record.
It'll be a really good history
lesson for Swordmen everywhere.
Thank you for letting me know.

scripts.speaker: Archeologist
scripts.text:
I'm so busy! Listen,
would you mind coming
back later when I'm not
so swamped with work?

scripts.speaker: Retired Soldier
scripts.text:
Why are you carrying
so much stuff with you?
Isn't there a Kafra Storage
service for keeping your junk?

scripts.speaker: Retired Soldier
scripts.text:
It's strange that so
many people have been
wanting to talk to me for
some reason, but I'll
admit that it's kind of nice.
Ask About Past Battles
Ask About Fallen Warrior

scripts.speaker: Retired Soldier
scripts.text:
Don't get me started.
Once I start talking about
the old days, I'll go on all
night. Those were real hard
times to live through, but good
memories to remember...

scripts.speaker: Retired Soldier
scripts.text:
The fallen warrior...?
There's only one that brings
a chill down my spine whenever
I think of him. He was about
your age when it happened...

scripts.speaker: Retired Soldier
scripts.text:
We received a report about
a Cobold threat, so we were
dispatched to the fields
west of Geffen. But the
battle was over once we
arrived. We were too late.

scripts.speaker: Retired Soldier
scripts.text:
All the Cobolds were slain,
